text:
Riya P: Heads up 14E2 We have a small wave of onboarding tickets that look like Dedicated infra/network blockers. Thinking a 30m 'surge triage' slot for hands-on config checks and a 60m deep-dive for full migrations. Anyone available to run pilot next Tue?
Jon H: I can do the 30m surge slot (evening NA). Prefer 02:30 UTC start. Keep it very focused.
Priya M: I'll take the 60m deep-dive. Can demo a live migration flow and common firewall/KMS steps. 13:00 UTC works for me.
Ben L: Suggest we have an intake form so we don't waste time on basics. Short checkbox form: infra type, region, IP allowlist done?, KMS required?
Riya P: Good call. I'll draft a 3-question intake and add a "priority: renewal-risk" checkbox. Link: https://rwd.co/forms/surge-intake
CS-Coord-Bot: New form template copied to /templates/surge-intake.md and webhook set to #customer-success when submitted.
Riya P: Proposed limits: 8 for deep-dive, 5 for surge triage. Keeps sessions actionable.
Jon H: +1 for limits. Also please add one "observer" seat reserved for AE/product reps to flag renewal concerns.
Priya M: Agenda for deep-dive (draft):
```
- 5m intros + outcome confirmations
- 15m migration demo (customer case)
- 25m live troubleshooting + logs review (bring support bundle)
- 15m action items & writeups
```
Ben L: Quick checklist snippet to drop in invite: `please attach support_bundle.zip and run: rwdctl health --include kvcache`
Riya P: I'll create calendar invites once we get intake responses. Poll here for preferred pilot slots: https://rwd.co/poll/surge-pilot (close Fri 11:59 PT)
CS-Coord-Bot: Poll created and ping scheduled. Reminder set 24h before close.
Ben L: Ops note: for Dedicated cases, enable a breakout channel during session (temporary channel) to post logs and IPs. Helps keep PHI/customer data out of main thread.
Priya M: Good. I'll own the breakout channel creation and cleanup.
Riya P: Owner assignments:
- Intake form + triage template: Ben L
- Deep-dive agenda + demo: Priya M
- Surge invite + RSVP message: Riya P
- Renewal-risk tagging + post-session follow-up: Jon H
Jon H: I'll add a follow-up template with fields: blocker, SLA impact, next step, AE owner, renewal-risk-level.
calendar-bot: Created tentative events: 4895007820 (Surge triage 30m), 4895007825 (Deep-dive 60m) in calendar 'CS Enablement Pilot'
Riya P: Final ask: if you want to reassign or swap, reply here with names and I'll update calendar. Also please review the intake form before we go live.
Ben L: Reviewed the form. Added an IP allowlist example and a Mismatch checklist item. Dropping file in #customer-success shortly.
Priya M: I'll prepare two short demo cases (one network, one KMS) and a minimal playbook for AEs.
Riya P: Thanks all :sparkles: Let's reconvene after poll closes and confirm attendees. End of thread.
